name: Palace Poker
summary: A strategic poker variant where players collect soldier cards and battle specific opponents to be last standing.
rules_text: Each player antes and receives one face-up banner card, dealt to maximize different suits among players. Each then receives three face-down palace cards. Remaining cards form a face-down draw pile with a face-down discard. On your turn you may: Buy by paying a small bet and drawing one soldier card face-up below your banner (max five, discard excess), Discard one or more soldiers for free, Bet against one opponent whose banner suit differs from yours, Stay, or Fold. Minimum battle bet is (soldier count + 1) times small bet. Defender may fold and be eliminated while attacker takes their face-up cards, call and compare best 5-card poker hands using banner+soldiers+palace (a card matching opponent's banner suit is dead), or raise. Loser of battle is eliminated and winner takes loser's banner and soldiers. If all remaining players in turn stay/discard/fold without a battle, showdown with highest poker hand wins. Last player standing wins pot; if 2-3 remain sharing banner suit, split.
rating_reason: Strategic poker variant, vying and bluffing with numeric bids.
reasons: capability: conditional_subsequence: the step list is flat: a whole BLOCK of steps cannot be chosen instead of another block. This is NOT a limit on conditional scoring or conditional updates: a single step can carry a `when` condition and a single operation an `if`, both arithmetic, so 'the poisoner scores if the choices match, otherwise the chooser' is fine
